traps: REVENUE DEFINITION (the headline trap): screener.in publishes TTM revenue of Rs 1,683 cr and stockanalysis.com publishes Rs 776 cr for the same bank on the same day - 2.17x apart - because one means gross interest earned and the other means net interest income + other income. A third reading, total income (interest earned + other income, ~Rs 1,799 cr), is what the filed result actually leads with. Any app that shows one number labelled 'Revenue' is wrong against two of the three conventions.

SCREENER COLUMN INVERSION: in screener's bank layout the column headed 'Interest' is interest EXPENDED, not earned ('Revenue' is the earned figure). Mapping 'Interest' to interest income inverts the spread and produces a bank that appears to pay more than it earns.

RIGHTS-ENTITLEMENT GHOST INSTRUMENT: the bundled BSE master carries 750942 / DHAN-RE / group R alongside 532180 / DHANBANK. DHAN-RE (ISIN INE680A20011) was the Jan-2025 rights entitlement - an expired, non-trading line with no price. Any prefix or fuzzy match on 'DHAN' can land on it, and it will resolve, and it will return nothing.
BRAND COLLISION ON 'DHAN': 'Dhan' is also a large Indian retail broking platform (dhan.co). A name- or news-based resolver searching 'Dhan' gets the broker, not the bank.

THREE LEGAL-NAME SPELLINGS: Dhanalakshmi Bank (pre-2010-08-10), Dhanlaxmi Bank (current legal name), and Dhanalaxmi (used by the issuer itself in its own FY2024-25 annual report filename). Exact-name matching fails across the bank's own archive.

DOMAIN MIGRATION: the long-standing IR domain dhanbank.com now 301-redirects to dhan.bank.in. Any stored first-party URL older than the migration rots, and the new domain's '.bank.in' TLD is unusual enough that naive URL validators reject it.

PER-SHARE SERIES CROSSES A RIGHTS ISSUE: share count went 25.30 cr -> 39.47 cr on 2025-02-04 (14:25 at Rs 21). Quarterly EPS before and after are on different denominators and screener does not restate them. EPS CAGR, per-share charts and book-value trends spanning Feb-2025 are arithmetically incoherent unless adjusted.

NO PROMOTER AT ALL: screener's shareholding table has no Promoters row; groww shows Public 85.75 / FII 14.21 / DII 0.05. promoter_pct is 0.00%/N-A by fact, and pledged_pct_of_promoter is UNDEFINED, not zero. A UI that renders 'Promoter holding 0%' as a governance red flag mis-signals an entire class of old private banks and PSUs.

FII JUMP IS A CORPORATE ACTION, NOT CONVICTION: FII holding doubles 6.95% (Dec-2024) -> 15.26% (Mar-2025) in the rights-allotment quarter. An agent narrating the shareholding series without the corporate action will report institutional accumulation that did not happen as described.

BANK RATIO CONVENTIONS: screener prints ROCE 5.81% for a bank, where deposits are operating liabilities and ROCE is meaningless; no source publishes D/E, and deriving it naively with deposits included gives ~13x, which reads as distress. Banks are judged on CRAR / NIM / GNPA / ROA.
BORROWINGS +269% IN FY26 (200 -> 737 cr) while deposits grew 16.4%. A generic leverage-spike heuristic flags this as deterioration; for a bank at 17.19% CRAR it is ordinary funding-mix activity.

BOOK VALUE SPREAD 34.16 / 37.35 / 38.3 across groww, balance-sheet derivation and screener - a 12% spread that flips the headline from 'trades 23% below book' to 'trades 15% below book'. For a bank, where P/B is THE valuation metric, this is the difference between two investment cases.
MARKET CAP SPREAD 1,145 - 1,165 cr, driven by share counts that straddle the rights issue (groww implies 38.85 cr shares vs the filed 39.47 cr).

ISSUER FILINGS ARE SCANNED IMAGES: both the Q1-FY27 results PDF and the Q1-FY27 investor presentation are image-only (JPXDecode, no text layer). Any 'cite the exact filing page behind this number' receipt feature cannot quote this issuer without OCR - and this is a mainboard NSE+BSE bank, not an obscure SME.

BSE BLOCKS AUTOMATED FETCHES: bseindia.com returned HTTP 403 for the scrip page during this collection. A pipeline that treats the exchange as its authority source silently loses its highest-authority tier on this name and falls back to aggregators - exactly where the definitional conflicts above live.

DEEP HISTORY IS LOSS-MAKING: FY2015 -Rs 241 cr and FY2016 -Rs 209 cr net loss. Any long-window CAGR, average-ROE or P/E-history calculation that spans them either divides by a negative base or silently drops years. screener's own 10-year profit CAGR (10%) and 5-year (22%) differ by 2.2x for this reason.
52-WEEK RANGE IS 1.89x (19.45 - 36.85). Auto-scaled charts and 'near 52w high/low' gauges built on rounded or stale ranges misplace the 29.47 last close, which actually sits mid-range.
